title: I Lift My Eyes to the Mountains

request.style: English, Celtic pilgrim song, clear male tenor vocal, uilleann pipes, Celtic harp, fiddle, low whistle, bodhran, open and walking, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I lift my eyes to the mountains
Where will my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD
Who made heaven and earth

[Chorus]
My help comes from the LORD
Who made heaven and earth

[Verse]
He will not let your foot slip
He who watches over you will not slumber
See, he who watches over Israel
Will neither slumber nor sleep

[Chorus]
My help comes from the LORD
Who made heaven and earth

[Verse]
The LORD watches over you
The LORD is your shade at your right side
The sun will not strike you by day
Nor the moon by night

[Chorus]
My help comes from the LORD
Who made heaven and earth

[Bridge]
The LORD will keep you from all harm
He will watch over your life
The LORD will watch over your going out and your coming in
Now and forevermore

[Chorus]
My help comes from the LORD
Who made heaven and earth

[Outro]
Your going out and your coming in
Now and forevermore
